'''Vanguard Missile Launchers''' were emplacement [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile systems]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. They were installed on [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] such as the [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|''FireStar''-class Orbital Defense Station]].<ref name="HS" />
